title: Minimum Effective Dose
hook: I wrote 3,000-word newsletters. The 600-word ones got more replies.
statement: Find the least effort that works. The rest is waste.
explainer: More effort feels safer. Usually it just burns time on nothing.
sop: Cut it in half for 2 weeks.
If Result holds, keep it lighter.
equation_example: Result 8 ÷ Effort 4 = 2.0. Double the return on every unit you put in.
question: Name one thing you could do at half effort.
closing_statement: Past what works is just waste.
